info.title: Skwirrel PIM API
info.description:
Skwirrel PIM API, version 3. JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTPS.

- Every call is `POST https://{customer}.skwirrel.eu/jsonrpc` (production) or `https://{customer}.skwirrel.dev/jsonrpc` (dev/test). The method name goes in the request body.
- Send the header `X-Skwirrel-Api-Version: 3`. Without it, core answers with the latest version.
- Authenticate with a static token in the header `X-Skwirrel-Api-Token` (default), or with OAuth2 client credentials: `POST /oauth2/token` with `grant_type=client_credentials`, `client_id` and `client_secret`, then send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. Access tokens are valid for one hour.
- A Skwirrel administrator grants access per method.

Errors come back as a JSON-RPC `error` object instead of `result`:

| Situation | HTTP | error.code | error.message |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wrong, expired or missing token | 401 | -32001 | Unauthorized |
| No grant for this method | 403 | -32002 | Method is forbidden |
| Too many requests | 429 | -32029 | Too many requests |

JSON-RPC has one URL for all methods. Each method is listed here as `/jsonrpc#<method>`: the part after `#` is never sent, so every call goes to `POST /jsonrpc`.

Use this page to browse the API. Sending requests from it (Try it out) only works when your Skwirrel environment allows cross-origin requests; otherwise use curl, Postman or Bruno.

post.summary: Check which of the supplied product IDs belong to a dynamic selection
post.description:
Sent as `POST /jsonrpc` with `"method": "checkProductsInSelection"` in the body.

Check which of the supplied product IDs belong to a dynamic selection

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `product_id` | integer[] | yes | Product IDs to check for selection membership |
| `dynamic_selection_id` | integer | yes | ID of the dynamic selection to check membership against |

**Example: Check membership in a selection**

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "checkProductsInSelection",
  "params": {
    "dynamic_selection_id": 1,
    "product_id": [
      1,
      2,
      3,
      4
    ]
  },
  "id": 1
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "in_selection": [
    1,
    2,
    3
  ],
  "not_in_selection": [
    4
  ]
}
```

product_id.description: Product IDs to check for selection membership

dynamic_selection_id.description: ID of the dynamic selection to check membership against

200.description: JSON-RPC response. On success `result` is set, on failure `error`.

post.summary: Delete a brand, optionally reassigning its products to another brand
post.description:
Sent as `POST /jsonrpc` with `"method": "deleteBrand"` in the body.

Delete a brand, optionally reassigning its products to another brand

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `brand_id` | integer (nullable) | no | Internal ID of the brand to delete |
| `external_brand_id` | string (nullable) | no | Your system's reference ID of the brand to delete |
| `reassign_brand_id` | integer (nullable) | no | ID of the brand to reassign this brand's products to before deletion |

**Example: Delete a brand**. Use reassign_brand_id to move the brand's products to another brand before deletion.

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "deleteBrand",
  "params": {
    "brand_id": 42
  },
  "id": 1
}
```

```json
{
  "brand_id": 42
}
```

external_brand_id.description: Your system's reference ID of the brand to delete

reassign_brand_id.description: ID of the brand to reassign this brand's products to before deletion

post.summary: Remove the ETIM classification and all associated feature values from a product
post.description:
Sent as `POST /jsonrpc` with `"method": "deleteEtimClassification"` in the body.

Remove the ETIM classification and all associated feature values from a product

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `product_id` | integer (nullable) | no | Internal product ID; required unless external_product_id is supplied |
| `external_product_id` | string (nullable) | no | External product ID; required unless product_id is supplied |
| `etim_class_type` | string | no | ETIM class type to remove: REGULAR or MODELLING |
| `etim_release` | string | no | ETIM release to remove (e.g. "ETIM-9.0"). Use "DYNAMIC" for MODELLING type |

**Example: Delete REGULAR classification**. All product_etim_feature rows for this product/type/release are removed first.

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "deleteEtimClassification",
  "params": {
    "product_id": 123,
    "etim_class_type": "REGULAR",
    "etim_release": "ETIM-10.0"
  },
  "id": 1
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "product_id": 123
}
```

product_id.description: Internal product ID; required unless external_product_id is supplied

external_product_id.description: External product ID; required unless product_id is supplied

etim_class_type.description: ETIM class type to remove: REGULAR or MODELLING

etim_release.description: ETIM release to remove (e.g. "ETIM-9.0"). Use "DYNAMIC" for MODELLING type

post.summary: Retrieve document attachments
post.description:
Sent as `POST /jsonrpc` with `"method": "getAttachments"` in the body.

Retrieve document attachments

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | integer | no | Page number (1-based) |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of results per page (1–1000) |
| `product_attachment_id` | integer[] (nullable) | no | Filter by internal attachment IDs |
| `attachment_collection_id` | integer[] (nullable) | no | Filter by attachment collection IDs |
| `file_sha256_checksum` | string (nullable) | no | Filter by exact SHA-256 checksum of the attachment file (64 hex characters) |
| `include_attachment_types` | string[] (nullable) | no | Only include attachments of these types; omit to include all types |
| `include_internal_attachments` | boolean | no | Include internal (non-public) attachments |
| `include_attachment_translations` | boolean | no | Include translated attachment names; requires include_languages |
| `include_attachment_attributes` | boolean | no | Include attachment attribute metadata |
| `include_attachment_categories` | boolean | no | Include categories linked to each attachment |
| `include_attachment_collections` | boolean | no | Include collection memberships for each attachment |
| `include_products` | boolean | no | Include products linked to each attachment |
| `include_custom_classes` | boolean | no | Include custom classification data for each attachment |
| `include_custom_class_id` | integer[] (nullable) | no | Only include custom classes with these IDs |
| `include_custom_collection_id` | integer[] (nullable) | no | Only include custom classes from these collection IDs |
| `include_languages` | string[] (nullable) | no | Language codes to include in translations (e.g. ["nl", "fr"]) |

**Example: First page of attachments**

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "getAttachments",
  "params": {
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 3
  },
  "id": 1
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "product_attachments": [
    {
      "product_attachment_id": 1,
      "product_attachment_type_code": "MAN",
      "source_type": "URL",
      "source_url": "https://example.com/manual.pdf",
      "for_internal_use": false
    }
  ],
  "page": {
    "number_of_items": 1,
    "items_per_page": 3,
    "number_of_pages": 1,
    "current_page": 1
  }
}
```

include_attachment_translations.description: Include translated attachment names; requires include_languages

include_attachment_categories.description: Include categories linked to each attachment

include_attachment_collections.description: Include collection memberships for each attachment

include_products.description: Include products linked to each attachment

include_custom_classes.description: Include custom classification data for each attachment

include_custom_class_id.description: Only include custom classes with these IDs

include_custom_collection_id.description: Only include custom classes from these collection IDs
